title: Advanced Communication
goal: Integrate everything into fluent, spontaneous, persuasive and professional English — debate, presentations, interviews, idiomatic range, critical reading and formal writing at C1.

modules.title: Fluency and Expression
modules.description: Fluency development, spontaneous conversation, advanced storytelling and persuasive communication at B2.

lessons.title: Fluency Development
objectives: Speak at length with reduced hesitation
Use fillers and reformulation naturally instead of stopping
lessons.assessment: Speak for 2 minutes on a familiar topic with natural flow

lessons.title: Spontaneous Conversation
objectives: React and respond in real time without scripts
Handle unexpected questions and topic changes
lessons.assessment: Sustain an unscripted 3-minute conversation on new topics

checkpoint.criteria: Speak spontaneously at length on familiar and new topics

lessons.title: Advanced Storytelling
objectives: Tell engaging stories with tension, pacing and point of view
Use narrative tenses and dramatic devices naturally
lessons.assessment: Tell a 2-3 minute story with clear structure and engagement

lessons.title: Persuasive Communication
objectives: Build a persuasive case: claim, reasons, evidence, call to action
Anticipate and answer objections
lessons.assessment: Deliver a 90-second persuasive pitch handling one objection

checkpoint.criteria: Tell advanced stories and build persuasive cases

modules.title: Formal and Professional
modules.description: Presentations, professional discussions and advanced interviews at B2→C1.

lessons.title: Presentations
objectives: Structure and deliver a 5-minute presentation with slides or notes
Handle audience questions fluently
lessons.assessment: Deliver a structured 5-minute presentation and field 3 questions

lessons.title: Professional Discussions
objectives: Argue a position in professional discussions with nuance
Disagree constructively and build on others' points
lessons.assessment: Defend a position across 6 discussion turns with nuance

checkpoint.criteria: Present and discuss professionally at C1 interaction standards

lessons.title: Advanced Interviews
objectives: Answer competency and behavioural questions with STAR structure
Handle salary, weakness and pressure questions
lessons.assessment: Complete a 10-minute mock interview with structured, specific answers

checkpoint.criteria: Perform in advanced interview formats with structured answers

modules.title: Precision and Depth
modules.description: C1 language mastery: advanced vocabulary, idiomatic expressions, debate, critical reading and formal writing.

lessons.title: Advanced Vocabulary
objectives: Use precise, nuanced word choices (mitigate versus reduce)
Build topic vocabulary for abstract discussion
lessons.assessment: Choose precise words in 12 of 14 nuance items and use 5 in speech

lessons.title: Idiomatic Expressions
objectives: Understand and use 20 core idioms, collocations and register markers
Avoid idioms in inappropriate registers
lessons.assessment: Use 8 of 10 target idioms correctly in context

checkpoint.criteria: Use advanced vocabulary and idioms with precision and register awareness

lessons.title: Debate
objectives: Build and rebut arguments in a formal debate format
Use debate language: signposting, concession, rebuttal
lessons.assessment: Deliver a 2-minute argument and one structured rebuttal

lessons.title: Critical Reading
objectives: Analyse argumentation, bias and evidence in demanding texts
Compare positions across sources
lessons.assessment: Map an author's argument and identify 3 bias instances with evidence

checkpoint.criteria: Debate formally and read critically at C1

lessons.title: Formal Writing
objectives: Write formal, well-structured texts (reports, essays, proposals) with C1 control
Match tone, cohesion and register to purpose and audience
lessons.assessment: Write a 350-word formal text with coherent argumentation and register control

checkpoint.criteria: Produce formal C1 writing with full cohesion and register control

exitAssessment.title: Advanced Communication Exit Test (Program Completion)
exitAssessment.criteria: A 5-minute presentation with Q&A; a formal debate exchange (argument plus rebuttal); a 10-minute advanced interview; a 350-word formal essay; critical reading analysis of a demanding text; idiomatic and precise vocabulary in use. Passing certifies TalkSy Complete English completion at the C1 standard.
